title: 英语文章润色优化---前言部分
description: I am writing the introductory section of a paper on deep learning and food metrics prediction for a leading academic food chemistry journal. In the introductory section I am trying to give a background on deep learning as it relates to food. Check that the sentence structure in the introduction conforms to English grammatical norms, including subject-verb agreement, use of tense, and verb forms. Please rephrase it for clarity, coherence and conciseness, ensuring each paragraph flows into the next. Remove jargon. Use a professional tone.
remark: 用于英文文章的润色，因前言部分与结果部分时态不尽相同，所以单独进行提示词的划分
